observations: Photo 0 shows a single car tire close-up (tread area visible).
Tread grooves are visible; there are signs of wear and dust/road grime.
No readable sidewall markings (size/brand/age) are visible in the provided photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show the sidewall text/markings where the size (295/40 R20) and brand/model (tukubo) would be readable.

risks.risk: Wrong tire size (295/40 R20) or wrong fitment; the photo doesn’t show the sidewall size markings.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tire sidewall showing the full marking (e.g., 295/40 R20) and any brand name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used tire with uncertain size/fitment (worst-case for buyer: may not match your vehicle).

risks.risk: Unknown condition/remaining tread depth; close-up suggests wear but depth is not measurable from this image.
risks.proof: A photo of tread depth measurement (tread gauge) or a clear shot showing the wear bars across the tread.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/near end-of-life used tire (worst-case: limited remaining tread).

risks.risk: Possible damage (cuts, bulges, sidewall cracks) not visible from the tread-only close-up.
risks.proof: Photos of the full tire including both sidewalls and the outer/inner edges, plus a close-up of any cracks/cuts/bulges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/needs inspection (worst-case: treat as not ideal for immediate use).

risks.risk: Age/production year unknown; rubber aging affects safety and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code (week/year) on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tire (worst-case: age unknown/assume not fresh).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the tire sidewall showing the full size marking (295/40 R20) and brand name (tukubo) if applicable.
Send a photo of the DOT code (week/year).
Send tread depth measurement (or a photo showing wear bars).
Send full tire photos: both sidewalls and any areas that show cuts, cracks, or bulges.
response.reason: The photo shows tread but does not provide readable sidewall markings to confirm the exact size/brand, and condition details (tread depth, DOT, damage) needed to price safely are missing. Request the sidewall/DOT and tread-depth proof first.
